title: Finite-diagonal hyper-Ext spectral sequence in the bounded-below second argument
statement:
Let $(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be a small ringed site, with a sheaf of commutative rings $\mathcal O$ and the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Use $D(\mathcal O)=D(\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O))$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], its standard cohomology and truncations [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category], and derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Let $K,L\in D(\mathcal O)$ and integers $r,c$ satisfy $H^j(K)=0$ for $j>r$ and $H^j(L)=0$ for $j<c$. Put $\mathcal Ext^p_{\mathcal O}(K,F)=H^pR\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O}(K,F[0])$ for a module sheaf $F$ and any integer $p$. There is a spectral sequence of module sheaves [def-sp-spectral-sequence]
$$E_2^{p,q}(L)=\mathcal Ext^p_{\mathcal O}(K,H^qL)\quad\Longrightarrow\quad H^{p+q}R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O}(K,L),$$
with $d_s$ of bidegree $(s,1-s)$. It is natural and additive in morphisms of $L$, including its abutment maps and filtrations. It vanishes outside $p\geq-r$, $q\geq c$. In total degree $n$ its abutment has a finite exhaustive separated filtration [def-sp-filtration, def-sp-convergence] with graded pieces $E_\infty^{p,n-p}$; only $c\leq q\leq n+r$ occur. In particular $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O}(K,L)$ has cohomology zero below $c-r$. No constructibility, finite Tor amplitude, or cohomological-dimension bound on the site is assumed.

source.place: Tag 015W, lemma-ss-filtered-derived: filtered-derived spectral-sequence method. The stated internal-Hom/Postnikov variant expands the passage from Ext continuity to representable sums in ILO XVII 10.1.1, proof p. 325; it is not a verbatim specialization of the ordinary left-exact-functor statement.
